item.title: Version 1.3.27
item.description: Fixes the Delivery Rename tab: it now scrolls (the stem names and the Rename button were cut off), with a visible gold scroll bar on every tab. Rename button moved to the bottom and made shorter; stem names go one per line; the Name bar fits on one line at any width with its heading above; mix version 1 becomes V1; mixer initials start blank. Everything from 1.3.26 (Delivery Rename, composer MIDI import, CLICK tempo source, stereo joins, Ref Check click-to-seek).
